headline: The Record Shows
epilogue: The final vote goes against you. The chair congratulates the room on listening, then moves to the next item before anyone asks what the listening was for.
reason: Replaces consoling commentary about preserved meaning with an action at the failed hearing.

headline: At Capacity
epilogue: The strain leaves you unable to continue, and the trip ends. Somewhere a motivational speaker is calling this a mindset problem from a chair someone else carried.
reason: Replaces the spendable sanity statistic with the experienced strain; keeps the joke aimed at privileged advice.

headline: Enough
epilogue: Accumulated strain ends the expedition. The speeches about resilience carry on, conveniently delivered by people who can send somebody else to answer the difficult questions.
reason: Removes narration about what the record preserves and keeps the cause as accumulated strain.

headline: Beyond a Spare Part
epilogue: The van is destroyed, ending the journey. Replacing it would cost more than grit, optimism, and an enthusiastic speech about taking responsibility can raise.
reason: Removes repair-choice instructions while retaining actual vehicle destruction without adding casualties or a location.

headline: Below What You Could Bear
epilogue: Cold exposure ends the trip. The advice to tough it out offers no shelter; its authors generally deliver it from heated rooms.
reason: Replaces the recorded-cause label with narration and directs the satire at insulated advice.

headline: Beyond the Forecast
epilogue: Heat exposure brings the trip to an end. A confident forecast could describe the conditions; it could not make them bearable.
reason: Removes the unsupported assertion that an accurate forecast was received while preserving heat exposure as the cause.

headline: The Van Has the Last Word
epilogue: Vehicle trouble ends the trip. Whatever could be argued about the government, the van has become the more immediate opponent.
reason: Removes the typed-outcome label without upgrading vehicle trouble to destruction or inventing rescue.

headline: Stranded Too Long
epilogue: The unresolved breakdown ends the trip. The van remains broken, and determination turns out to be an extremely poor substitute for a working part.
reason: Removes the instruction distinguishing this outcome from a completed repair; keeps the breakdown unresolved.

headline: The Repair That Didn’t Happen
epilogue: The van is still broken when the expedition ends. The repair never comes together; the route map has become an ambitious suggestion for somebody else’s vehicle.
reason: Avoids claiming that a missing spare specifically caused the unresolved breakdown.

headline: Beyond This Point
epilogue: The crossing failure ends the expedition. The destination remains elsewhere, beyond a route that cannot carry this journey any farther.
reason: Removes an invented sign and denial of permission; crossing failure alone does not establish either.

headline: The Case Is Still Packed
epilogue: The journey is unfinished. Washington has a talent for turning delays into permanent arrangements; this one has not become a verdict.
reason: Removes save-record narration and the unnecessary assertion about an unseen hearing without declaring an outcome.

headline: The Road Can Wait
epilogue: The journey remains unfinished. If there is another stretch, Washington is unlikely to have run out of things that need explaining.
reason: Removes the instruction to keep the record and makes any continuation conditional.

headline: The Last Page Is Missing
epilogue: The account breaks off before it says how the journey ended. Somewhere, a press office could make a triumph out of that much blank space.
reason: Removes the reference to a game and preserves the unknown outcome through an in-world account.

headline: The Missing Ending
epilogue: The account ends without an outcome. A press office could probably fill the gap by lunchtime; finding out what happened would take actual work.
reason: Replaces commentary about retained facts and hired staff with narration that leaves the outcome unknown.

headline: An Unanswered Question
epilogue: What became of the journey is unknown. No grand conclusion emerges from the silence, although that has rarely stopped a podium from being wheeled out.
reason: Removes the official-looking screen reference without inventing a journey result or anyone’s fate.
